text: The new isempty lookup and IsEmpty() expression allow filtering empty geometries on PostGIS.
suggestion_reason: The PostGIS geometry lookup changes database filtering behavior.

text: django.contrib.auth.hashers.SHA1PasswordHasher, django.contrib.auth.hashers.UnsaltedSHA1PasswordHasher, and django.contrib.auth.hashers.UnsaltedMD5PasswordHasher are deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code using the named password hasher classes needs review before their removal.

text: From Django 5.1+ string literals will be implicitly interpreted as JSON string literals.
suggestion_reason: The interpretation of string literals in JSONField queries changes.

text: django.core.mail.backends.smtp.EmailBackend now verifies a hostname and certificates. If you need the previous behavior that is less restrictive and not recommended, subclass EmailBackend and override the ssl_context property.
suggestion_reason: SMTP TLS certificate and hostname verification affects mail deployment settings.

text: The old DEFAULT_FILE_STORAGE and STATICFILES_STORAGE settings are deprecated as of this release.
suggestion_reason: Project storage settings are deprecated and need configuration review.

text: Running the makemigrations command will generate a migration containing a django.db.migrations.operations.RenameIndex operation which will rename the existing index. Next, consider squashing migrations to remove index_together from historical migrations.
suggestion_reason: makemigrations generates an index-rename database migration.

text: QuerySet now extensively supports filtering against window-functions with the exception of disjunctive filter lookups against window functions when performing aggregation.
suggestion_reason: QuerySet filtering against window functions changes ORM query behavior.

text: ModelAdmin.list_editable now uses atomic transactions when making edits.
suggestion_reason: Admin list edits now use database transactions.

text: The new django.contrib.auth.forms.BaseUserCreationForm is now the recommended base class for customizing the user creation form.
suggestion_reason: Custom user-creation form code can use the new base class.

text: Be aware that psycopg 3 introduces some breaking changes over psycopg2. As a consequence, you may need to make some changes to account for differences from psycopg2.
suggestion_reason: The note says psycopg 3 may need changes but does not identify whether code or environment is the first check.

text: The usage of QuerySet.iterator() on a queryset that prefetches related objects without providing the chunk_size argument is no longer allowed.
suggestion_reason: Code calling QuerySet.iterator with prefetching must pass chunk_size.

text: The new asynchronous functions are now provided, using an a prefix: django.contrib.auth.aauthenticate, django.contrib.auth.aget_user, django.contrib.auth.alogin, django.contrib.auth.alogout, and django.contrib.auth.aupdate_session_auth_hash.
suggestion_reason: Authentication code can call the new asynchronous functions.

text: QuerySet.bulk_create and QuerySet.abulk_create methods now set the primary key on each model instance when the update_conflicts parameter is enabled (if the database supports it).
suggestion_reason: bulk_create now sets primary keys on updated model instances.

text: In order to improve accessibility, the admin's main content area and header content area are now rendered in a <main> and <header> tag instead of <div>.
suggestion_reason: The admin page renders different HTML landmark elements.

text: The get_joining_columns() method of ForeignObject and ForeignObjectRel is deprecated. Starting with Django 6.0, django.db.models.sql.datastructures.Join will no longer fallback to get_joining_columns(). Subclasses should implement get_joining_fields() instead.
suggestion_reason: ForeignObject subclasses should implement get_joining_fields instead.

text: django.test.runner.DiscoverRunner now allows showing the duration of the slowest tests using the test --durations option (available on Python 3.12+).
suggestion_reason: The test runner can now display durations in command output.

text: Django 5.0 introduces the concept of a field group, and field group templates. This simplifies rendering of the related elements of a Django form field such as its label, widget, help text, and errors.
suggestion_reason: Form field groups change the rendered label, widget, help text, and error layout.

text: Properties in ModelAdmin.list_display now support boolean attribute.
suggestion_reason: Boolean properties change what the admin list displays.

text: The new escapeseq template filter applies escape to each element of a sequence.
suggestion_reason: The template filter changes rendered escaping of sequence elements.

text: Facet counts are now shown for applied filters in the admin changelist when toggled on via the UI. This behavior can be changed via the new ModelAdmin.show_facets attribute. For more information see facet-filters.
suggestion_reason: Facet counts appear in the admin changelist UI.

text: In order to improve accessibility, the admin's changelist filter is now rendered in a <nav> tag instead of a <div>.
suggestion_reason: The admin filter now renders as a nav element for accessibility.

text: The BaseUserManager.make_random_password() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Calls to the removed make_random_password method must change.

text: Overriding existing converters with django.urls.register_converter() is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: URL converter registration code can no longer override an existing converter.

text: To enable this, add "django.contrib.auth.middleware.LoginRequiredMiddleware" to your MIDDLEWARE setting.
suggestion_reason: Enabling the authentication middleware requires changing MIDDLEWARE settings.

text: The new OGRGeometry.is_3d attribute allows checking if a geometry has a Z coordinate dimension.
suggestion_reason: Application code can use the new OGRGeometry.is_3d attribute.

text: In order to enforce test isolation, database connections inside threads are no longer allowed in django.test.SimpleTestCase.
suggestion_reason: SimpleTestCase code that opens database connections in threads must change.

text: ReadOnlyPasswordHashWidget now includes a button to reset the user's password, which replaces the link previously embedded in the ReadOnlyPasswordHashField's help text, improving the overall accessibility of the django.contrib.auth.forms.UserChangeForm.
suggestion_reason: The password reset control changes from a link to a button in the form UI.

text: The new exclusion argument of django.db.models.expressions.RowRange and django.db.models.expressions.ValueRange allows excluding rows, groups, and ties from the window frames.
suggestion_reason: RowRange and ValueRange change window-frame query semantics.

text: django.utils.text.Truncator used by truncatechars_html and truncatewords_html template filters now uses html.parser.HTMLParser subclasses. This results in a more robust and faster operation, but there may be small differences in the output.
suggestion_reason: HTML truncation template filters can produce slightly different output.

text: The JavaScript file collapse.js is removed since it is no longer needed in the Django admin site.
suggestion_reason: The note only says an admin JavaScript asset is removed because it is no longer needed; it states no downstream behavior to check.

text: The new field_id argument for django.forms.ErrorList allows an HTML id attribute to be added in the error template. See ErrorList.field_id for details.
suggestion_reason: ErrorList can render an HTML id attribute in its error template.

text: HttpRequest.accepted_types is now sorted by the client's preference, based on the request's Accept header.
suggestion_reason: Code reading HttpRequest.accepted_types now receives client-preference order.

text: Added support for validation of model constraints which use a django.db.models.GeneratedField.
suggestion_reason: GeneratedField constraints change model data validation.

text: GDAL now supports curved geometries CurvePolygon, CompoundCurve, CircularString, MultiSurface, and MultiCurve via the new OGRGeometry.has_curve property, and the OGRGeometry.get_linear_geometry and OGRGeometry.get_curve_geometry methods.
suggestion_reason: GIS code can use the new geometry property and conversion methods.

text: The new HttpResponse.text property provides the string representation of HttpResponse.content.
suggestion_reason: Code can read the new HttpResponse.text property.

text: To improve accessibility for screen reader users aria-describedby is used to associate form fields with their error messages. See how form errors are displayed for details.
suggestion_reason: Form errors now render an aria-describedby link for screen readers.

text: The attributes UniqueConstraint.violation_error_code and UniqueConstraint.violation_error_message are now always used when provided. Previously, they were ignored if UniqueConstraint.fields was set without a UniqueConstraint.condition.
suggestion_reason: ValidationError code and message from UniqueConstraint change for callers.

text: The new django.forms.SearchInput form widget is for entering search queries and renders as <input type="search" ...>.
suggestion_reason: SearchInput renders an input type=search element.

text: QuerySet.explain now supports the memory and serialize options on PostgreSQL 17+.
suggestion_reason: QuerySet.explain changes PostgreSQL query-plan output options.

text: The new Expression.allows_composite_expressions attribute specifies that the expression allows composite expressions, for example, to support composite primary keys.
suggestion_reason: Custom Expression code can set allows_composite_expressions.

text: CSP policies can now be enforced or monitored directly using built-in tools: headers are added via the django.middleware.csp.ContentSecurityPolicyMiddleware, nonces are supported through the django.template.context_processors.csp context processor, and policies are configured using the SECURE_CSP and SECURE_CSP_REPORT_ONLY settings.
suggestion_reason: CSP policies, middleware, and settings require security configuration review.

text: django.urls.register_converter() no longer allows overriding existing converters.
suggestion_reason: Code registering URL converters must stop overriding existing converters.

text: Using a percent sign in a column alias or annotation is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Column aliases and ORM annotations using percent signs need query review.

text: The new Lexeme expression for full text search provides fine-grained control over search terms. Lexeme objects automatically escape their input and support logical combination operators (&, |, ~), prefix matching, and term weighting.
suggestion_reason: Lexeme changes full-text search expression and query behavior.

text: The framework provides task definition, validation, queuing, and result handling. Django guarantees consistent behavior for creating and managing tasks, while the responsibility for running them continues to belong to external worker processes.
suggestion_reason: The task framework spans task-definition code and external workers; the note does not establish one first check.

text: The new order_by argument for django.db.models.Aggregate allows specifying the ordering of the elements in the result.
suggestion_reason: Aggregate order_by changes the ordering of query results.

text: coveredby and isvalid lookups, django.contrib.gis.db.models.Collect aggregation, and django.contrib.gis.db.models.functions.GeoHash and django.contrib.gis.db.models.functions.IsValid database functions are now supported on MariaDB 12.0.1+.
suggestion_reason: The new GIS lookups and functions affect MariaDB database queries.

text: Email handling in Django now uses Python's modern email API, introduced in Python 3.6. This API, centered around the email.message.EmailMessage class, offers a cleaner and Unicode-friendly interface for composing and sending emails. It replaces use of Python's older legacy (Compat32) API, which relied on lower-level MIME classes (from email.mime) and required more manual handling of message structure and encoding.
suggestion_reason: Email integration code may need review for the modern email API.

text: If you haven't dealt with this warning by now, add DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD = 'django.db.models.AutoField' to your project's settings, or default_auto_field = 'django.db.models.AutoField' to an app's AppConfig, as needed.
suggestion_reason: The note explicitly tells projects to update DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD configuration.

text: As the internal implementations of django.core.mail.EmailMessage and django.core.mail.EmailMultiAlternatives have changed significantly, closely examine any custom subclasses that rely on overriding undocumented, internal underscore methods.
suggestion_reason: Custom EmailMessage subclasses overriding internal methods need code review.
